Class StaticLoanRepository

java.lang.Object
lms.persistence.StaticLoanRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoanRepository
public class StaticLoanRepository extends Object implements LoanRepository
In-memory implementation of LoanRepository using a static HashMap.

Stores loans in a map with support for CRUD operations and complex queries by user, item, status, and date ranges. Includes loan statistics and validation with custom exceptions. This implementation is not thread-safe and intended for testing purposes.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Majd Awwad
